headline: Markets closed today for Dussehra holiday; Sensex plunged 876 points in the last trading session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: BSE and NSE equity markets are closed on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in observance of Dussehra.
In the last session on October 19, Sensex dropped 876.37 points to close at 73,852.90.
Nifty fell 1.11% in the last session to settle at 22,888.95.
Banking and IT stocks led the broad-based losses during the previous trading day.
whatHappening: Trading on BSE and NSE remains suspended today due to a scheduled stock market holiday.
Regular market trading will reopen on Wednesday, October 21, 2026.
IPO-bound Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.50 crore from anchor investors ahead of its issue opening on October 21.
EAAA India Alternatives announced its IPO set to open on October 26 to raise Rs 1,200 crore via an OFS.
summary: Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, for the Dussehra holiday. In the last trading session on October 19, the Sensex dropped 876.37 points while Nifty dropped to 22,888.95, led by declines in banking and IT shares. Normal trading on the exchanges will resume on Wednesday, October 21.
